rationale.conceptual: The method is an established correlated wavefunction theory (MP2, MP4) with customized basis sets (Huzinaga/Dunning with polarization functions). Correctly setting up basis I and II and applying frozen-core MP4(SDQT) requires careful implementation, but no novel algorithm.
rationale.execution: The pipeline has three distinct stages: MP2 geometry optimizations, HF geometry optimization + frequency calculation, and MP4 single-point + derived energetics, all for eight species. Managing basis set specifications and multiple calculations introduces moderate orchestration, but all within standard quantum chemistry software.

difficulty.reasoning: The task uses standard ab initio methods (MP2, HF, MP4) with customized basis sets on small triatomic molecules. The conceptual difficulty is moderate: understanding and implementing the specific basis set and correlation methods is non-trivial. The execution involves a multi-step pipeline with several calculations per species, but no heavy data engineering. Resources are minimal (CPU-only, tiny memory/disk).
